record, and let your own computer clean and transcribe
Pierre Gallaz · developed with Claude Code

Recordings stay on this phone, and the phone itself transcribes them with Whisper (the model is fetched once). A cloud folder is optional (WebDAV: kDrive, Nextcloud…): then each recording is also uploaded there, and if the small worker from the app\'s repository runs on your computer, it takes over the cleaning and the transcription with a much bigger model; transcript and cleaned audio come back here. Nothing goes to Google.

How to host recordings on kDrive (Infomaniak)
1. Open kDrive in a browser. Its web address contains a number after /drive/ — for example ksuite.infomaniak.com/kdrive/app/drive/123456/… — that number is all the app needs as the server.
2. Username: the e-mail you log in to Infomaniak with.
3. Password: your Infomaniak password. If two-factor authentication is on, create an application password instead (Infomaniak Manager → Security → Application passwords) and use that one.
4. The app creates a folder named Recordings at the root of your kDrive and puts every recording there, with a small .json beside it. Rename or delete a recording in the app and the folder follows.
5. To get transcripts and cleaned sound back, run the worker script from the app's repository on a computer where the kDrive app syncs that folder; it leaves a .txt and a cleaned .mp3 next to each recording, and the phone fetches them at the next sync.
Nextcloud and any other WebDAV server work the same way: give the full https:// address as the server.
